# Will your resume even reach a human? Run the copy-paste test.

> Free ATS resume checker, no sign-up and nothing uploaded. Paste the text copied out of your resume and instantly see the formatting issues that break applicant-tracking-system parsing — then paste a job posting to see which of its keywords your resume covers and which it never mentions.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
